summary: Kristen Major, 29, of Montrose reported missing after hiking in the Nucla area; reported at 10:30 p.m. Tuesday after failing to return; overnight search by Civil Air Patrol, MCSO Investigations, Colorado Parks and Wildlife, MCSO K-9 units, MCSO drones, and the Montrose County Sheriff's Posse; found safe the morning of 2020-04-22
responding_agency: Montrose County Sheriff's Office (+ Civil Air Patrol, CPW, Sheriff's Posse)
notes: Run 747 insert — Montrose County Sheriff blotter chunk; found safe 2020-04-22 morning per source update.
